I answered Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message: the contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals at Quarrendon Freight Lines is Thea Ramaswell.

That comes from Dana's post in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025, a channel Marcus is in. Dana wrote that Thea had flagged duplicate arrivals on door 6 again on the morning shift. The same trailer showed up twice, once from the kiosk check-in and once when dispatch added it by hand. Dana owns the account and said she was looking into it. I told Marcus that I haven't seen any later update on the issue.

I left out the seat-count changes from that thread because they didn't bear on his question.
